command: W_IP=$(ip route show default | awk '{print $3}'); exec npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest -u http://${W_IP}:9223

if ! curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9224/json/version > /dev/null 2>&1; then nohup /snap/bin/chromium --remote-debugging-port=9224 --remote-debugging-address=0.0.0.0 --user-data-dir=/tmp/chromium-wsl-profile --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check --disable-features=TFLiteLanguageDetectionEnabled about:blank > /tmp/chromium-wsl.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 10); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9224/json/version > /dev/null && break; sleep 1; done; fi; exec npx -y @playwright/mcp@latest --cdp-endpoint http://127.0.0.1:9224
